blocks.content: Pick the project that excites you most—there's no wrong choice.
Each one will teach you valuable skills and give you a real sense of accomplishment.
Once you've completed your chosen project, you can jump back into Learn Python Basics and complete the rest of the course. Or, you can also challenge yourself by building all three!
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
